summary: This Wikipedia-derived note is a biography of James Hubert Farmer, a retired American professional basketball player born September 23, 1964. It covers his selection by the Dallas Mavericks in the 1987 NBA draft, his physical profile as a small forward, and his five NBA seasons across five teams. It also notes his best season, 1990-91 with the Denver Nuggets, and his college career at the University of Alabama.
one_line: Biography of James Hubert Farmer, a retired American NBA small forward drafted 20th overall in 1987 who played for five teams.
key_facts: James Hubert Farmer was born on September 23, 1964.
James Hubert Farmer is a retired American professional basketball player.
James Hubert Farmer was drafted by the Dallas Mavericks in the first round, 20th pick overall, of the 1987 NBA draft.
James Hubert Farmer was a 6'4" 190 lb small forward.
James Hubert Farmer played for the Dallas Mavericks, Utah Jazz, Seattle SuperSonics, Philadelphia 76ers, and Denver Nuggets in 5 NBA seasons.
James Hubert Farmer's best NBA stint was the 1990-91 season.
During the 1990-91 season, James Hubert Farmer appeared in 25 games for the Denver Nuggets and averaged 10.0 points per game.
James Hubert Farmer played collegiately at the University of Alabama.
